research_notes: Follow-up: locate public DFAT annual-report/posting and gazette evidence for appointment, full-time terms, leave and 2001–2002 transition; identify farm/bar employers, student-work dates and 2009–2010 work. Verify university course boundaries and separate departmental from ministerial payroll.

Reviewed APH, two government biographies and maiden speech on 2026-09-29. First speech adds overseas/student work not represented in short occupation list. Three nights per week supports part-time coding only; no FTE estimated.

A third party's existing public FOI request was inspected read-only: thread is marked refused and shows June decision/July internal-review correspondence. It supplies no disclosed personnel evidence here; requested date range is not proof of actual employment. No new FOI, contact or outreach initiated.

Year-only intervals and possible adjacent-year gaps are preserved. Do not count farm upbringing as employment or extend DFAT years from the FOI question. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; initial record remains unresolved.

2026-10-02 follow-up: contemporary government Ramsar delegation report independently identifies second-secretary role in May1999; Monash confirms1999 qualification year. Targeted DFAT/annual-report/gazette and farm-work searches did not resolve hours, leave, exact posting boundaries or farm/bar employers. ABC2019 Wannon profile search result describes two years Danish agricultural exchange, whereas first speech describes a year out; do not convert either into dated tenure without reconciliation. Additional public archives-request thread https://www.righttoknow.org.au/request/archives_act_access_request_dan could not be fetched (DisabledError); no personnel disclosure established, applicant assertions not adopted. Next: contemporary DFAT appointment/separation instruments,1999 study overlap,2001–02 transition and2009–10 work. No duration calculated.

2026-10-03 follow-up: a contemporaneous 13 November 2009 ABC Radio transcript identifies Tehan as Liberal candidate for Wannon before his 21 August 2010 election. The campaign interval is recorded as excluded party activity so it is not mistaken for paid employment; no source establishes remuneration, hours or concurrent work. Fresh searches of DFAT/posting, ACCI, ministerial-office and Wannon campaign material did not resolve DFAT full-time terms, exact 2001-2002 transition, party-role endpoint, or any paid 2009-2010 employment. Candidacy is evidence of activity, not evidence of unemployment or a job. Next: DFAT appointment/separation instruments and archived Liberal Victoria or campaign payroll records. No duration calculated.

2026-10-04 follow-up recovered the previously inaccessible National Archives correspondence for public request NAA1000448692. NAA reported on 11June2026 that its RecordSearch description search found no Tehan employment record and inferred the relatively recent personnel file was likely still in DFAT custody; the applicant withdrew rather than registering for NAA to contact DFAT. NAA also identified Embassy Mexico series A10004, A10432 and A14110 but no name-searchable personnel item, and explained that departmental records are not indexed by officer name. This is documented archival-route evidence, not proof of employment boundaries or secondment. No new dates/hours were added. Decisive avenue: DFAT-held employment file or a subject-specific embassy item; no outreach was sent.
